camel_example: aliyun vod ListAppPoliciesForIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType RamUser --AppId 'app-0000' --IdentityName test0000name
description_en: Invokes this operation to list the application permissions granted to a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
description_zh: 调用本接口列出指定账号身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）被授予的应用权限的列表
kebab_example: aliyun vod list-app-policies-for-identity --identity-type RamUser --identity-name test0000name --app-id app-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAppPoliciesForIdentity

parameters.description_en:
The identity type. Valid values:
- **RamUser**: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
- **RamRole**: RAM role.
